rationale: The agent correctly authenticated the user via full name and zip, accessed the correct account, and retrieved accurate order details. It provided the correct tracking number and tablet storage, and identified the Chicago order as delivered. However, it performed an account write (updating the default shipping address) without first obtaining the user's explicit confirmation, which violates the policy requirement to state the exact change and get consent before any record-changing action. Additionally, it ambiguously stated that a cancelled order was “shipped to Denver” without clear tool support and, when asked if the Chicago package was still in transit, deferred to the carrier instead of reiterating the internal status (delivered). The lack of confirmation before the address update is the primary reason for failure.
